rappel_detail.notes: Concord south face rappel 1 of 2, about 30 m on a single 60 m rope, to the bolted mid-face station.
hazards: Keep this south-face line distinct from Concord’s North Face rappels; their stations must not be mixed.
rappel_detail.station: The top of Concord Tower, on the south side toward Lexington Tower.

rappel_detail.notes: Concord south face rappel 2 of 2, about 30 m, into the Concord-Lexington notch.
rappel_detail.station: The bolted station partway down Concord’s south face.

set.rappels: 2 single-rope rappels of about 30 m down the south face from the summit chains to the Concord-Lexington notch, the second from a bolted mid-face station (two ropes make it one). The north face also goes, in three stages, but ropes tend to stick there.
set.rappel_count_note: Two single-rope rappels of roughly 30 m each down the south face, with a bolted station partway down. This is a separate line from the North Face rappels into the Liberty Bell-Concord notch.
